observation_summary: Compilation fails with 'message not initialized using goog.getMsg' when a variable name starts with 'MSG_'.
reasoning_summary: The compiler incorrectly assumes that any variable name starting with 'MSG_' must be a message object that requires initialization via 'goog.getMsg'. This heuristic is applied too broadly, causing valid JavaScript code that happens to use the 'MSG_' prefix for non-message variables to trigger false-positive compilation errors (JSC_MSG_NOT_INITIALIZED_USING_NEW_SYNTAX) when using ADVANCED_OPTIMIZATIONS.
